notes: Research proposal (research/ROLE-GOALS.md). Ranks are priors from a 400-game pilot (bands 2-3) plus published and coaching sources; re-check with metricImportance on production data per role and band. Targets come from the player's band, never from this file. Phase: early = by ~14 min; habit = player-controlled; whole-game = follows the result.

top.label: lane cs at 10 min
top.why: Lane minions are your main source of gold and experience, and the top role quest rewards farming your own lane.
tips: Last-hit first, trade second: a lost wave costs more than a won trade.
Recall after crashing a wave into their tower, not mid-wave.
Use Teleport early to get back to lane fast and save the next wave.

top.label: deaths before 14 min
top.why: Top is the most isolated lane, so an early death hands over gold, plates and waves before the game is decided.
tips: Ward river or tri-brush before you push past the middle of the lane.
If you can't see the enemy jungler, assume they're near your lane.
Recall before you're too low to fight one more trade.

top.label: gold lead on your lane opponent at 14 min
top.why: Gold difference in the early game is one of the few stats that predicts the winner, and it shows how your lane went.
tips: Trade when your wave is bigger than theirs.
Count plates: every plate is gold your opponent doesn't get.

top.label: turret plates
top.why: Plates turn a lane lead into gold and map pressure before they fall, though teammates share the credit.
tips: After a kill or their recall, hit the tower before you back.
Void Grubs speed up tower damage: join grubs when your wave is pushed.

top.label: control wards placed
top.why: A control ward is a cheap habit that guards your lane from ganks whatever the result of the game.
tips: Buy one control ward on your first back and put it in river or tri-brush.

jungle.label: jungle cs at 10 min
jungle.why: Camps are the jungler's main income, and steady farm keeps you on level for ganks and objectives.
tips: Finish your full clear before ganking unless a lane is clearly gankable.
Never walk past a camp that's up: take it on the way.
If a gank fails, go straight back to farm.

jungle.label: gank kills before 10 min
jungle.why: Early ganks deny the enemy gold, which is where the best junglers pull ahead of others.
tips: Gank when two hold: enemy pushed, no flash, no ward, your laner has CC.
Come from behind the enemy, not up the lane.
Gank at level 3, level 6 or right after your first item.

jungle.label: deaths before 14 min
jungle.why: An early death costs the jungler farm, camp timers and control of the next objective.
tips: Track the enemy jungler: if you saw them top, path bot.
Don't invade without lane priority from the nearby laners.

jungle.label: early dragons, grubs and herald
jungle.why: Objectives drive win chances, and counting only the early ones keeps the measure from just following the result.
tips: Ward the next objective a minute before it spawns.
Start dragon or grubs only when your nearby lanes can move first.
Keep Smite up for the objective.

jungle.label: enemy wards cleared
jungle.why: Clearing wards hides your pathing and ganks, and it is a habit you control whatever the score.
tips: Swap to sweeper once your early ganks are done.
Sweep the objective area before a fight.

jungle.label: control wards placed
jungle.why: Control wards hold vision at objectives, where the jungler decides fights.
tips: Put a control ward on your side of the next objective.

middle.label: lane cs at 10 min
middle.why: Farm is a mid laner's base for every roam and fight, and it rises clearly with rank.
tips: Shove the wave before you roam so you lose no minions.
Use the cannon wave timing to recall.

middle.label: deaths before 14 min
middle.why: Mid is in reach of both junglers, and dying there gives the enemy mid free roams.
tips: Keep a ward on one side of mid and play toward it.
When their jungler is missing, stop pushing past half the lane.

middle.label: takedowns before 10 min
middle.why: Early kills and assists capture the roams and skirmishes that make a mid laner matter on the map.
tips: Roam right after you push or kill your laner, never mid-wave.
Roam to lanes with CC or kill pressure; skip lanes that can't follow.

middle.label: gold lead on your lane opponent at 14 min
middle.why: Gold difference in the early game is one of the few stats that predicts the winner, and it shows how your lane went.
tips: Trade when your wave is bigger than theirs.
Push first, then roam, so your opponent loses farm following you.

middle.label: turret plates
middle.why: Plates turn a lane lead into gold before they fall, though teammates share the credit.
tips: After a kill or their recall, hit the tower before you back.

middle.label: control wards placed
middle.why: One control ward near mid makes ganks visible and is a habit you control.
tips: Keep one control ward in a mid-lane side brush or river.

bottom.label: lane cs at 10 min
bottom.why: A bot laner's power comes from farm, and the bot role quest pays out for lane minions.
tips: Under tower: let the tower hit melee minions twice, then last-hit.
Crash the wave before you recall.

bottom.label: deaths before 14 min
bottom.why: Bot lane gets ganked most, and an early death also hands the enemy a free dragon.
tips: Don't trade when their wave is bigger: minion aggro hurts.
Stand behind your minions against hooks and skillshots.

bottom.label: cs lead on your lane opponent at 10 min
bottom.why: Comparing your farm with your lane opponent's shows whether you won the lane, not just whether it was easy.
tips: Hit them when they walk up to last-hit while your support zones.

bottom.label: turret plates
bottom.why: Plates turn a bot lead into gold before they fall, though teammates share the credit.
tips: After a won fight or a dragon, hit plates before you back.

bottom.label: takedowns before 10 min
bottom.why: Early two-versus-two kills snowball bot lane and the dragon side of the map.
tips: Fight when your support's engage and your level spike line up.

utility.label: control wards placed
utility.why: Control wards are the support's clearest habit: higher ranks place more, and it doesn't depend on winning.
tips: Buy a control ward on every back.
Place it where you'll fight next: dragon pit edge or river bush.
A control ward in your inventory gives no vision: place it.

utility.label: wards placed before 14 min
utility.why: Early wards measure vision before the result shows, avoiding the winning-team bias of end-of-game vision score.
tips: Use your support item's wards right away.
Ward river before the enemy jungler's first gank.

utility.label: enemy wards cleared
utility.why: Clearing enemy vision is a habit you control, and it denies the enemy the information to fight you.
tips: Swap to sweeper once your support item's quest is done.
Sweep before dragon, not during it.

utility.label: deaths before 14 min
utility.why: Supports often die early while warding or roaming alone, which leaves the bot laner exposed.
tips: Ward from your side of the river, not deep and alone.
Roam only when your bot laner can stay safe without you.

utility.label: vision score per minute
utility.why: The familiar vision number, but it favours the winning team and rewards activity over quality, so it comes last.
tips: Wards in unwarded spots score more than wards next to others.

newMetrics.computation: frames[10].participantFrames[me].(minionsKilled + jungleMinionsKilled) minus the same for the enemy participant with the same teamPosition; skip without frame 10 or a unique opponent
frames[14].participantFrames[me].totalGold minus the enemy participant's with the same teamPosition; skip without frame 14 or a unique opponent
timeline WARD_PLACED events with creatorId == me, timestamp < 840000 and wardType in YELLOW_TRINKET, SIGHT_WARD, CONTROL_WARD, BLUE_TRINKET

timeline ELITE_MONSTER_KILL events with timestamp < 840000, monsterType in DRAGON, HORDE, RIFTHERALD, killerTeamId == my team, and killerId == me or me in assistingParticipantIds (verify that field is filled; fallback: my position in the nearest frame within 2000 units of the event position)
timeline WARD_KILL events with killerId == me and timestamp < 840000
frames[4].participantFrames[me].jungleMinionsKilled (descriptive: whether the first full clear finished)
timestamp of my first ITEM_PURCHASED after 90000 ms that is not within 60 s after a CHAMPION_KILL with victimId == me; approximate (no recall event); descriptive, direction unclear
sum of Data Dragon gold.total of my ITEM_PURCHASED events within 20 s of firstBackSec, minus ITEM_UNDO; descriptive, direction unclear
count of frames 3..10 where my position is within 2000 units of an allied laner's position (minute granularity, coarse); descriptive
count of frames 3..14 where my position is more than 3000 units from my bot laner's position; context only (patch 26.16 penalises heavy early support roaming)
